C1520.title: PhantomRaven Malware Steals GitHub Tokens via 126 Malicious npm Packages
C1520.summary: Researchers uncovered a malware campaign dubbed PhantomRaven that distributes 126 malicious npm packages designed to steal GitHub tokens through remote dependencies, posing a serious threat to developers and projects relying on these open-source packages.
